lessons.text: Clicking 'Post payable' on /erp/bills/new may fail with HTTP 500 if the ERP session has expired; recover by reopening /erp/bills/new and signing in again before refilling and posting.

To record a bill in the ERP GUI, open /erp/bills/new, fill 'Total payable (INR, incl. tax)', 'Supplier ref #', 'Supplier', and other required fields, then click 'Post payable'; success redirects to the bill detail page.
On the bill detail page, set the 'Payment date' field to the due date (YYYY-MM-DD) and click 'Schedule payment' to schedule payment; the system returns a confirmation message.
ERP read-only API GET /bills accepts query parameters vendor_id and invoice_number for duplicate checking; an empty array means no existing bill for that vendor and invoice.
To send an internal confirmation email, open /mail/compose, fill 'To', 'Subject', and 'Message' fields, then click 'Send'.
